tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i cho ga nyung ngu rnam gsal bzhugs so/ /

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen mthingasngon lta bur gsal ba'i sku/ /mtshan dpe'i gzi ldan 'od kyi dra ba can/ /mthong thos dran pas ngan song gnas spong ba'i/ /mi 'khrugs lha yi mchog khyod phyag gi gnas/ /ring du sbyangs pa'i rnam dpyod 'od dkar gyis/ /mtha' yas rgyud don ku mud ta yi tshal/ /legs par phye ba las byung cho ga'i tshul/ /ma 'dres go bde'i ngag gis bshad kyis nyon/ 'dir bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas gshin po rjes su 'dzin pa'i nyin gcig pa'i cho ga la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi/ dang po ni/ gzhi bzang po'i steng du/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor dgram mtha' bskor du dbang ldan nas g.yas bskor mtshams 'dzin dang*/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga phyogs mtshams su mdzes par bshams/ lhor gtor ma cha gsum dang rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu bum pa la sogs pa 'og tu dgos pa thams cad tshogs par byas te stan la 'dug nas/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bdag bskyed/ bum bzlas/ mdun bskyed bsgrub cing mchod pa/ 'jug cing dbang blang ba/ tshe 'das rjes su bzung ba/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i mjug gi bya ba dang drug las/ dang po ni/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjaud pas bgegs bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ zhu ba las 'byung ba'i lhas rdza las grub pa'i mchod yon/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ gzhan yang rol mo dang phan gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dwangs shing thog pa med pa sa dang nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar bsams la/ de'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ rol mo ji snyed pa'i sgra bya zhing*/

dharma ra ṇi la sogs pa brjod do/ / de nas bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro ci nus byas nas/ chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa yin pa la/ de ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs te/ sangs rgyas kyi sa la dgod par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ / snyam du sems bskyed de/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje mi 'khrugs par gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas se gol bya zhing*/ nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na mo ak+ṣo bh+ya sa pā ri wā re bh+yaḥ chos dbyings mnyam pa nyid las ma g.yos kyang*/ /thugs rjes rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' bar/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don sgrub lhur mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ak+ṣo bh+ya sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+pe dhu pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi t+ya/ shap+ta pū dza me gha mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ zhes pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags bya/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom nas/ oṃ shu+u n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ gis dngos po thams cad stong pa nyid du yun ring du bsgom ste/ tshogs gnyis bsags pa'o/ /de nas stong pa'i ngang las glang po ches btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ huṃ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus hūṃ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog in+d+ra nī la ltar sngo ba/

zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas sa gnon dang*/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi steng na rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor cog can/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs dang*/ dar gyi shams thabs can/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par bsam/ de nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya gnas gsum tu gtugs la/ kāṃ ka ni/ lan gsum bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs te/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa ni gzhi dang po'o/ / de nas snying ga'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad mi 'khrugs pa gtso bor gyur ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ zhes pas mchod yon phul/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa 'khor dang bcas pas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rang nyid la thim nas/ snying gar pad zla'i steng du/ dbus su mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas sa gnon dang*/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ shar du rnam snang dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan ser po g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ byang du don grub ljang khu g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ thams cad kyang dar gyi na bza' dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan gyi brgyan pa/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'od dang 'od zer 'phro ba'o/ / de ni gzhi gnyis pa zhes bya'o/ / de nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ak+ṣo bh+ya sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tī tsa pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/

de bzhin du pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe la sogs la'ang sbyar/ phyag rgya bcas pas mchod la/ rdo rje thal mo snying gar bzhag pa g.yas su bskor zhing*/ rnam dag pad+mo'i dbus kyi lte ba la/ zhes sogs brjod pas/ bstod par bsam mo/ /de nas rang gi snying ga'i mi bskyod pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i ste du/ gzungs sngags sbrul 'khyil ba lta bur bkod la/ de las 'od 'phros ngan song thams cad zhi bar byas/ slar 'dus snying ga'i chos kyi yi ge la thim par bsam zhing*/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ kāṃ ka ni kāṃ ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ tra sa ni tra sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba karmā pa raṃ pa ra ṇi me swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzlas la/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod pas/ bsgom bzlas kyi byin rlabs brtan par bsam la/ slar yang bdag nyid la mchod bstod bya ba'i phyir/ mchod rdzas rnams bsangs sbyangs byin gyis rlabs nas thal mo sbyar la/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams/ / rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas 'gro ba'i don kun mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ak+ṣo bh+ya sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad dang*/ sngags rnams go brjes la/ me tog dang puṣ+pe bdug spos dang dhu pe snang gsal dang*/ ā lo ke dri mchog dang gan+dhe zhal zas dang nai wid+ya rol mo dang shap+ta rnams kyis mchod la/ rdo rje dril bu dkrol zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi tā/ pra ra ṇi ta / saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li ni/ pra dzñā pā ra mi ta na da swa bhā watwa/ badz+ra satwa hriḥd ya san+to ṣa ṇi hūṃ hāṃ hūṃ ho ho ho a khaṃ swāhā/

zhes pas rol mo ci 'byor bar 'bul lo/ /de nas dril bu 'dzin pas/ rnam dag pad+mo'i dbus kyi lte ba la/ / rab brjid glang po pad+ma zla ba'i gdan/ /sa bon hūṃ las rgyal ba'i skur bzhengs pa'i/ /bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku mdog sngon po mtshan dpes legs brgyan zhing*/ /phyag g.yas sa gnon phyag rgyas 'gro ba 'dul/ / g.yon pa mnyam bzhag steng du rdo rje 'dzin/ /bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun kyis dbang bskur zhing*/ /byams dang dngos grub kun gyi rtsa ba ste/ /snying rjes sems can kun gyi sgrib pa sbyong*/ / bcom ldan= shin tu tshogs bsags ye shes 'byor pa'i sku/ /nges tshig ldan pa yid 'ong dag pa'i gsung*/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin gdod nas rnam grol thugs/ /bcom ldan mi= stobs bcu'i dbang phyug rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /ma lus 'dus pa bde gshegs kun gyi gtso/ /rgyal ba kun las lhag pa'i thugs rje can/ bcom ldan= thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dpal gyi be'u nas/ / sa bon sngags las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /ngan song sdug bsngal ma lus sbyong mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan= de ltar bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /bdag dang khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi/ /thogs med bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags kun/ /bcom ldan mi 'khrugs mgon pos sbyang du gsol/ zhes pas bstod de bdag bskyed do/ / gnyis pa bum bzlas ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i steng du/ dung chos dri bzang gi chus gang ba dang*/ rdo rje me tog phreng ba dang bcas pa bzhag la/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las dang pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su/

paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ glang po ches btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan/ 'dab ma brgyad la zla ba'i gdan/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsams nas/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya bya/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bcom ldan 'das/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*/ /mchod pas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ak+ṣo bh+ya sa pa ri wā ra e h+ya hi/ zhes pas spyan drangs shing*/ spyan drangs pa'i mi 'khrugs pa 'khor bcas bum pa'i nang du byon par bsams la/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs par sku mdog in+d+ra nī la ltar sngo ba= zhes pa nas/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar gyi gtso bo gsal btab/ shar du lha mo pad+ma can dkar mo zhes pa nas/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba'o/ / zhes pas lha mo rnams gsal btab la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ak+ṣo bh+ya sa pā wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza megha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ de bzhin du rol mo'i bar sngags dang phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod la/ rdo rje dril bu bsil zhing*/ nam mkha'i mdangs ltar kun nas gsal ba'i sku/ /mtshan dpes rab mdzes rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs/ /rdo rje dang bcas mnyam bzhag sa gnon mdzad/ /mi 'khrugs rgyal ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha yi rnga bo che ltar rnam kun tu/ /rnam par rtog med legs bshad seng ge'i sgra/ /yan lag drug cus brgyan pa legs sgrogs pa'i/ /mi 'khrugs rgyal ba'i gsung la= ye shes rgya mtsho yon tan nor bus gtams/ /cho 'phrul rnam par 'khrul ba'i rba rlabs can/ /srid zhi rlung gis rnam par mi g.yo ba'i/ /mi 'khrugs rgyal ba'i thugs la= dus gsum rgyal ba'i yon tan ma lus rnams/

/ ye shes rang bzhin sgyu ma'i skur bstan nas/ /mi 'khrugs rgyal ba'i 'phrin las kun sgrub pa/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pas bstod/ bum nang gi mi 'khrugs pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du gzungs sngags kyi 'phreng ba bkod pa la dmigs te/ gtso bo la kāṃ ka ni dang*/ 'khor rnams la rang rang gi sngags ci nus dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye swāhā/ zhes sogs ci 'grub bzlas pas/ lha so so'i sku las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'dzag pas sdig pa 'khrud nges kyi ye shes kyi chu nus ldan du byin gyis brlabs nas/ sngar bzhin mchod bstod/ dung chos kyi chu phul bas ye shes pa gshegs par bsams la/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis brtan par bya'o/ / gsum pa dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa ni/ ras bris zhal phye la/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ sarbabhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa de yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba gur dang bla re/ phyi rol ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swāhā/ de'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ baṃ laṃ bh+rū ཾ las byung ba'i rin po che'i gzhal yas khang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i stegs bu la gnas pa/ gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa phyi nas rim pa bzhin du/ dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du/ /rin po che'i pha gu ser pos bskor ba/ de'i steng du rin po che'i bre phul gyis bteg pa'i gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su/ chu srin gyi kha nas byung ba'i dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa dang*/ zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang*/ dril bu dang*/

me tog gi 'phreng ba dang*/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can 'phyang ba/ de'i steng nas thur du 'phyang ba'i mda' yab dang*/ de'i steng na rin po che'i dra mig gseng ma'i pu shus bskor ba/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la gnas pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas mchod byed pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams dang grwa bzhir zla ba phyed pa la gnas pa'i rdo rje nor bus spras pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng du/ rdo rje'i gdung zlum de'i steng du rdo rje'i thal gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje dang nor bu rin po che'i tog gis spras pa sgo bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs rim pa bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtser mor/ pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ gdugs dang*/ g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang*/ snam bu so so la rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan la sogs pa'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus sngo ba'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar glang po ches btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ gtso bo sgrub thabs ltar bskyed/ 'dab ma brgyad la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du shar du shaṃ las dpal be'u shaṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ lha mo pad+ma can dkar mo g.yas na dpal be'u 'dzin pa/ lhor paṃ las pad+ma paṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ 'od ldan ma dmar mo g.yas na pad+ma 'dzin pa/ nub tu tshaṃ las gdugs tshaṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ mdangs ldan ma sngon mo g.yas na gdugs 'dzin pa/ byang du shaṃ las dung shaṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las dri med ma ljang khu g.yas na dung 'dzin pa/

shar lhor tsam las 'khor lo tsaṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ 'jigs byed ma dkar mo g.yas na 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu dh+waṃ las rgyal mtshan dh+waṃ gyis mtshan pa/ yongs su gyur pa las gnas bcas ma sngon mo g.yas na rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ nub byang du kaṃ las bum pa kaṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las dkar sham ma dmar skya g.yas na bum pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du maṃ las gser nya maṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las yid gzhung ma ljang khu g.yas na gser nya 'dzin pa/ lha mo brgyad po thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas pa rang rang gi phyag mtshan thugs kar gtod de 'dzin pa/ phyag g.yon khu tshur sta zur g.yon du brten pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'dzum zhing yid du 'ong ba'i rnam pa can rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs kyis mdzes pa/ zla ba'i gdan dang rgyab yol can/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba

ra bsam mo/ / de nas dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang gnyis su med par gyur bar bsam ste/ dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'o/ /de nas sngar bdag bskyed kyi skabs ltar sngags dang phyag rgyas gnas gsum byin gyis rlabs la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags dang phyag rgyas spyan drangs par bsams la/ spos dang bcas pas/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bcom ldan 'das/ / bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*/ /mchod pas bdag la dges par mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta yak+ṣo bh+ya sa pā ri wā ra e h+ya hi/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+wam/ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ spyan drangs pa'i bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs par bsams la/ mchod pa rnam pa lngas mchod/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bstan te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ud bha ba ya swāhā/ zhes pas lha thams cad mnyes par bsam ste ye shes pa spyan drangs pa'o/ /de nas dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ spyan drangs pa'i ye shes sems dpa' rnams lha rang rang gi thugs kar bzhugs par dmigs la/ sems rtse gcig tu gtan nas/ 'od zer gyi spro bsdus sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs bar bsams la/ gtso bo la gzungs ci nus bzla/ 'khor rnams la/ oṃ maṅga laṃ shri bta sa bā na ye swāhā/ oṃ maṅga laṃ pad+ma swāhā/ oṃ maṅga laṃ tsha traṃ ga swāhā/ oṃ maṅga laṃ shaṃ kha swāhā/ oṃ maṅga laṃ tsakra swāhā/ oṃ maṅga laṃ dh+wa dza swāhā/ oṃ maṅga laṃ ka la sha swāhā/ oṃ maṅga laṃ ma tas+ya swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzlas la/ dkyil 'khor brtan bzhugs byas te/ mdun bskyed sgrub pa'o/

/de la mchod pa'i phyir gtso bo las cha gcig chad nas/ shar sgor gnas par bsams la/ mchod pa rnams byin gyis rlabs la/ thal mo sbyar nas/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla re dang*/ /mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste/ /mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas/ /bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ ces dang*/ pad skor sngon du 'gro ba'i so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ak+ṣo bh+ya sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ zhes pas mchod yon dang*/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad dang sngags gong 'og thams cad 'dra bar byas la/ me tog phal cher dang puṣ+pe/ bdug spos dang*/ dhu pe/ snang gsal dang*/ ā lo ke dri chab dang*/ gan+dhe/ zhal zas dang*/ nai wi d+ya/ sil snyan phal cher dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ak+ṣo bh+ya sa pā ri wā ra shap+ta pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ zhes dang rol mo ji snyed pa'i sgra bya zhing*/ dharma ra ṇi ta la sogs pa brjod/ de nas bkra shis rtags brgyad 'bul ba ni/ mgon po thugs rje chen pos byin rlabs pa'i lha rdzas las grub rin chen dpal be'u mchog /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ zhes dang*/ pad skor sngon du 'gro ba'i so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ak+ṣo bh+ya sa pā ri wā ra maṅga laṃ shrī bad+sa bāṃ na pū dza megha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ zhes dang de bzhin du tshigs bcad dang*/ sngags gong 'og thams cad 'dra bar byas la/ lha rdzas las grub rin chen pad+ma mchog / ces dang*/ maṅga laṃ pad+ma rin chen gdugs mdzes mchog / dang*/ tsha traṃ ga /dung dkar mchog dang*/ shaṃ kha/ 'khor lo mchog dang*/ tsakra /rgyal mtshan mchog dang*/ dha dza/ bum pa mchog dang*/ ka la sha /gser nya mchog dang*/ mat+sa pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ de nas/

oṃ las rin po che sna bdun sprul te/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta ya/ ā brta ya ho/ zhes brjod cing*/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ak+ṣo bh+ya sa pā ri wā ra tsakra rat+na pū dzi te hūṃ/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la/ /nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas/ /dbul zhing 'phongs pa rgyun bcad nas/ /'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /ma ṇi rat+na= btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de/ /shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /wasti rat+na= blon po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan/ /bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin zhing*/ / yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /ma hās+t+wa rat+na= /glang po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal nas/ /bla med theg par rab bzhon te/ / thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /hasti rat+na= /rta mchog rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol te/ /rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas/ /sangs rgyas zhing du bgrod par shog /tū raṃ ga a shwa rat+na=dmag dpon rin chen 'di 'phul bas/ /nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas/ /phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de/ /bsnyengs bral mchog ni thob par shog /khaḍ+ga rat+na= zhes brjod cing dbul/ de nas 'dod yon lnga 'bul te/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan/ /phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog cing mchis pa/ /mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul gyi/ /bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ak+ṣo bh+ya sa pā ri wā ra rū pa ka ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūṃ/ de bzhin du/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i/ /yon tan tshig mchog sgra snyan ci mchis rnams/ /mos blos=

bzhes shig= shap+ta= phyogs dus kun na tsan+da sbrul snying dang*/ a kar nag sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams/ mos blos= bzhes shig= gan+dhe= phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i/ /lus sems rtas byed ro mchog ci mchis rnams/ mos blos= bzhes shig= ra sa= phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khris chags pa'i/ /reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim byed rnams/ /mos blos= bzhes shig= oṃ sarba ta th+wa ga ta ak+ṣo bh+ya sa pā ri wā ra s+pha ra she ka ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūṃ/ zhes pas mchod do/ / de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas dbyangs snyan pos bstod de/ chos dbyings ye shes byang chub sems bdag nyid/ /sku gsum mchog brnyes thugs rjes chen po yi// 'gro ba'i las sgrib ma lus sbyong mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan mi 'khrugs mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyed sku in+d+ra nī la'i lhun po las/ /nyi ma bye ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba bzhin/ /mtshan dpes rgyan gsal 'od kyi dra ba can/ /bcom ldan= mi g.yo rdo rje skyil krung rab bcings nas/ /bdud 'dul mnyam bzhag steng na rdo rje can/ /thor gtsug lha yi na bza' mchog mdzes pa/ /bcom ldan= khyed gsung sngags zab rtag tu dus gsum mam/ /lan gcig bzlas pas las kun zad pa dang*/ /mtshams med sbyong dang bar chad kun sel ba'i/ /bcom ldan= /sngags bris lus la btags pa tsam gyis kyang*/ /dus min 'chi spong snying rjes dud 'gro sogs/ /'chi tshe rna bar bsgrags pas ngan 'gro bzlog /bcom ldan mi= gang gi ched du ming smos brtse ba yis/ /brgya stong 'bum phrag gang rung bzlas brjod kyis/ /dmyal bar skyes pa'ang mod la thar mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan mi= gzhan yang khrus dang brab sogs bya ba dang*/ /mchod rten la sogs sdig chen sbyong ba yis/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis thar pa'i bde ston pa/ /bcom ldan mi= khyed thugs mkha' ltar spros kun nyer zhi yang*/ /spangs rtogs mkhyen brtse'i nyi zla skar tshogs kyis/

/log blo'i sgrib sel dge legs kun mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan mi= stobs sogs rgyal ba'i yon tan rin chen gyi/ /'byung gnas 'gro ba'i re bskong dpag bsam shing*/ /'phrin las phan bdes nam mkha' khyab mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan= ye shes tshad med bzhi'i ngo bo nyid/ /'phags lam rnam thar brgyad rnams rnam dag cing*/ /bcom ldan 'phrin las bkra shis kun mdzad ma/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar bstod pa'i dge ba'i 'gro ba kun/ /nyon mongs las kyi sgrib pa kun byang nas/ /gzungs sngags phan yon la sogs 'grub pa dang*/ /tshogs gnyis mthar phyin byang chub mchog thob shog /ces pas bstod de 'das pa'i lha mchod pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas gtor ma rnams chu gtsang mas bran la/ dang po phyogs skyong dang*/ gnyis pa 'byung po spyi la cha gsum ltar dbul/ gsum pa cha gsum ltar bgegs gtor sbyin/ gtor ma phyi rol du dor la/ khro bo'i sngags kyis mtshams bcad de/ 'jig rten pa gtor mas mchod pa'i cho ga'o/ /bzhi pa 'jug cing dbang blang ba ni dkyil 'khor gtso bor rang gi sngar mi 'khrugs pa'i dbang zhus pa'i bla mar mos la/ 'jug pa'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul te/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu//mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ / zhes sogs bdag bskyed ltar rgyun bshags lan gsum byas la/ oṃ tsak+ṣuḥban+dha wa ra a ma na ya hūṃ/ zhes dang*/ ras dmar pos mig dar bcings par bsam/ a khaṃ wī ra hūṃ/ zhes me tog gi 'phreng ba blang*/

oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa kyis bgegs bsangs la/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ /skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ /de yi bu la ci zhig bya/ /sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go / de nas/ snying gar kun rdzob byang sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ de'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa bsams la/ rdo rje reg cing*/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa ta ya mi su ra te sa ma ya stāṃ/ ho sidhi badz+ra ya tha su khaṃ/ zhes pas ba rtan par bsams la/ rdo rje mgo bor bzhag ste/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ / zhes pas gsang bar gdams nas a khaṃ wā+e ra hūṃ/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs par bsams/ oṃ na ma te hūṃ/ oṃ na ma me hūṃ/ na mo na ma hūṃ/ zhes lus ngag yid gsum dang bas phyag byas la/ ye shes dbab pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pas lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ rang mi 'khrugs par gsal ba'i sku lus la/ mdun bskyed kyi lha thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin hūṃ gi rnam par byon nas lus la char bab pa bzhin zhugs nas/ snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ye shes sems dpa' hūṃ gi rnam par zhugs par bsam la/ de bzhin du a yig dmar po dpag tu med pa byung ste/ ba spu'i bu ga nas sib sib thim pas/ sems rgyud ye shes lnga'i ngo bor byin gyis rlabs par mos la/ rdo rje dang dril bu gnyis ka lag pa g.yas kyis mgo bo'i steng du dkrol zhing*/

gzungs sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra a be sha ya a a a/ zhes brjod/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brjod cing brtan par mos la/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor la me tog phul nas/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+waṃ/ i maṃ satwa mahā ba la/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong gyur bas/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ dzñā na tsak+ṣu hūṃ a/ dkyil 'khor la lta bar bskul ba'o/ /'jug pa'i cho ga'o/ /gnyis pa la dbang bskur ba dngos dang*/ mtha' rten sbyin pa gnyis las/ dngos gzhi don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab la/ rang nyid dbang stegs kyi dbus na rdo rje mi 'khrugs par gsal ba'i steng du gdugs dkar po g.yas su rgyal mtshan/ g.yon du ba dan/ phyogs kun tu rnga bo che dang*/ dung la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas/ sangs rgyas spyan/ mā ma kī / gos dkar mo/ sgrol ma ste rigs kyi yum bzhi'i phyag na bum pa dag byed bdud rtsi'i chus gtams pa bsnams nas dbang bskur ba'i las mdzad/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ kāṃ ka ni 'i mjug tu/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing*/ bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/

tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las ngan sdig sgrib dag par bsam pa ni chu'i dbang ngo*/ / de nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ud bha we swāhā/ zhes brjod cing*/ phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag pa'i rkyen gyis mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan par bsam pa ni cod pan gyi dbang ngo*/ /de ltar rang nyid bya ba'i rgyud kyi rdo rje slob dpon chen por gyur pa la/ mchod pa rnam pa lngas mchod nas/ bya ba'i rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor chen por zhugs/ chu dang cod pan gyi dbang bskur ba thob/ nyon sgrib dang shes sgrib dag /chos can dang chos nyid gnas gyur/ gzugs kyi sku dang chos kyi sku mngon du byed pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ / zhes dbang gi rtogs bskyed dran par bya ste/ dngos gzhi'o/ /gnyis pa mtha' rten sbyin pa la/ khrus byab bsrung ba gsum gyi dang po ni/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ /thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med/ /byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te/ /ci 'dod dngos grub stsal tu gsol/ oṃ maṅga laṃ shrī bat+sa bā na sarba pā paṃ shin+taṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu/ /yid 'ong legs par bkang bas glu dang ni/ /rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ oṃ maṅga laṃ pad+ma

nas shin+taṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa/ /gtong ba dri yis legs bsgos chu/ /khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bya'o/ /oṃ maṅga laṃ tsha traṃ nas/ shin+taṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ de nas tshig rkang dang po'i sbyin pa 'i gnas su tshul khrims dang ser sna 'i gnas su khrims 'chal dang*/ gtong ba 'i gnas su tshul khrims sbyar la/ oṃ maṅga laṃ shaṃ kha nas/ ku ru ye swāhā/ de bzhin du/ bzod pa dang khong khrau/ oṃ maṅga laṃ tsakra nas/ ku ru ye swāhā/ brtson 'grus dang le lo/ oṃ maṅga laṃ dha dza nas ku ru ye swāhā/ bsam gtan dang rnam g.yeng*/ oṃ maṅga laṃ ka la sha nas/ ku ru ye swāhā/ shes rab dang shes 'chal/ oṃ maṅga laṃ mat+sa sarba nas / ku ru ye swāhā zhes brjod cing*/ bum chu cung zad btung ba dang*/ gdong pa la byug pa'i tshul byas nas gzungs tshar gcig brjod pa'i rjes su/ sarba pā paṃ shin+taṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ sarba bigh+na na = sarba dz+wa re bh+ya ra = sarba u pa dra be shin+taṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ sarba gra he shin+taṃ= sarba kā la mṛ d+ya= sarba dur swa ba ni dur ni mi t+ti= sarba tsi ta bh+yaḥku le shin+taṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ de nas lag pa g.yas kyis rma bya'i mjug sgros byab pa'i tshul du bya zhing*/ gzungs kyi mthar/ sarba pā paṃ a pa na ye swāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ sarba bigh+nan sogs gong du brjod pa rnams kyi mthar/ a pa ni ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing*/ de nas bgegs slar mi 'jug par bya ba'i phyir/ gzungs kyi mthar/ sarba bigh+nan bh+ya rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ zhes brjod cing spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su rdo rje bzhag la bsrung ba bya'o/ /de nas spyi bor me tog cung zad cig gzhag la/ rdo rje dril bu gsil zhing*/ ston mchog dam pa sogs sho lo ka gsum gyi mthar/ nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ / nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing*/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa/

/skyabs mchog gsum gyis bde legs stsol/ /oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ / zhes lan gsum brjod/ dbang thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rags tu maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ khyod kyi slob mar bzung ba dang*/ /cha shas kyis kyang spyad du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum brjod de/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'o/ /lnga pa gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu tshe 'das rjes su 'dzin na/ sngar sbyor ba'i skabs su dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su sbyong stegs khru gang ba'i pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su/ 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa bri/ de'i steng du rus pa'am/ ming byang bzhag /sbyang ba'i yo byad dang*/ bye ma'am yungs kar la sogs gshin don la dgos pa'i yo byad la sogs pa thams cad bsham mo/ /de nas bdag 'jug yan rdzogs par bya/ bzlas pa'i skabs rnams su bye ma'am yungs kar la sngags kyis brabs la bzhag go /de nas ming byang la sogs pa'i rten de/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swā bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sbyong stegs kyi steng du/ tshe 'das kyi ming gi yi ge dang po'am/ ṇi las tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba'i phung po dang*/ khams dang*/ skye mched thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gson po'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur par bltas la/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ dang tshe 'das kyi snying ga'i ṇi las 'od 'phros pas/ tshe 'das kyi rnam shes khams gsum gang na gnas pa nas bkug par bsam/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ ngag tu/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo rnams kyi = bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba thugs rje'i bdag po mi 'khrugs pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang*/

bden pa chen po'i byin gy-is brlabs kyis tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba/ khams gsum skye gnas bzhi/ /rigs drug gang na gnas kyang 'dir mchis par gyur cig /oṃ ṭak+ki hūṃ dzaḥ zhes pa gsum dang*/ bdag dang mdun bskyed kyi bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ tshe 'das la thim pas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag nas rnam par shes pa a dkar po dri ma med par bsam mo/ /de nas bgegs sbyang ba'i phyir/ gtor ma rten la bskor zhing*/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga bh+yo/ bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ud ga te s+pha ra ṇaṃ i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ne daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis zhi bas sbyangs/ sum+bha brjod/ rdo rje gsor zhing*/ ting lo dang chang bu rten la bskor ba gsum gyis zhi drag phyed nas sbyangs nas/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo la gson gyi dus na tshe gnas pa la bar du gcod cing*/ gshin gyi dus na sdig pa sbyong ba la bar chad byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad gtor ma 'di lam rngan/ ting lo lam sgron/ chang bu lam rgyags kyi tshul du khyer la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig / ces brjod cing rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūṃ ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad sreg /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms/ /dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can/ /log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba/ / rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs so 'tshal/ /log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod kyi gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza sa pā ri wā ra e h+ye hi sa spyan drangs/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+pe/

dhupe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ naiwid+ya/ shap+ta hūṃ gis mchod/ hūṃ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las/ /'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing*/ / thabs la mkhas pas 'jig byed skur ston pa/ khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can/ /gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras/ /ma lus dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing*/ /sdig pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams/ /nyon mongs dug can rtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa/ /sbrul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bskal ba me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /dpa' bo'i stangs stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis/ /bgegs dpung sreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs/ /rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrogs/ khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra nges sgrogs shing*/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ zhes pa nas/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo la/ gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag la rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i sbyang ba rnam par dag pa byas zin pas des tshim par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i rdo rje 'bar zhing cher 'bar ba 'dis/ khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar dgas par bgyi'o/

/ zhes dang*/ rten la gu gul gyis bdug /yungs kar gyis brab/ rol mo rtag tu bya/ sum+bha ni la sogs pa'i drag sngags mang du brjod pas/ bgegs dang bral bar bsam mo/ /de nas/ tshe 'das kyi sdig pa thams cad kaṃ nag po'i rnam pas sna bug nas thon/ sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam pas til la thim/ de'i g.yas su me dang*/ g.yon du chur dor bas sdig sgrib thams cad sregs shing sbyangs pa bsams la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod pas mer bsreg cing chur dor ro/ /de nas bye ma'am yungs kar la kāṃ ka ni la sogs pa lha thams cad kyi sngags mang du bzlas/ de'i nus pa thams cad bstim la/ rus pa'am ming byang mdun du bzhag pa la brab ste/ kāṃ ka ni'i 'jug tu sarba na ra ka ga te he tu na hū phaṭa/ tshe las 'das pas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi dmyal bar skye ba'i rgyu las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par gyur cig / de bzhin du kāṃ ka ni dang*/ sarba pra te ga ga te he tu na hūṃ phaṭa/ yi dwags su skye bo'i rgyu = de bzhin du tir+ya ka ga te he tu na hūṃ phaṭa/ dud 'gror skye ba' = sogs gong bzhin sbyar zhing*/ de nas khrus bya ste/ rnam rgyal bum pa thogs la/ thog mar dkyil 'khor me long bstan te/ ji lta bltams pa sogs dang*/ / 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ /thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med/ /byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te/ /ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu/ /yid 'ong legs par bkang ba'i glu dang ni/ /rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ sogs kyis khrus gsol/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o/ /oṃ hūṃ traṃ hrī aḥkā ya bi sho dha ni swāhā/ zhes pas sku phyi'o/

/de nas khrus byas pa'i chu de slar yang bum pa'i nang du blug la de nas bum chus nub gong ma rnams la me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba la bkru/ tha ma la rten dngos su bkru zhing*/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa/ /gtong ba dri yis legs bsgos chu/ khrus legs mdzad kyi khrus bya'o/ / de bzhin du tshig rkang dang po dang*/ gsum pa'i gnas su/ tshul khrims/ bzod pa/ brtson 'grus/ bsam gtan/ shes rab rnams gzhug rkang pa gnyis pa'i ser sna'i gnas su/ khrims 'chal/ khong khro'i/ le lo/ rnam g.yeng*/ shes 'chal rnams bcug la/ tshig bzhi pa lnga pa dang*/ chu bo drug gis khrus byas nas/ /bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni/ /gang la nyes pa mi mnga' zhing*/ khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dri chu drug gis khrus byas pas/ /bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni/ /rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa/ khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga'/ /dri ma rnams drug dag pa yis/ /yon tan thams cad ldan pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du/ /dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ / zhes pa'i tshig bzhi pa dang*/ kāṃ ka ni/ re spel zhing bkrus nas/ mthar/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mos/ gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi pha rol du phyin pa drug gi mi mthun pa'i phyogs dag nas/ pha rol du phyin pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan dug mi mnga'/ /sangs rgyas bden pa'i dug bcom mo/ / tshig rkang gsum pa dang bzhi par/ bcom ldan dam chos = dam chos bden pas = 'phags pa'i dge 'dun = dge 'dun bden = zhes sogs sbyar ba'i tshig bzhi pa gnyis brjod cing*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis tshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i nyon mongs pa dug gsum gyi sgrib pa thams cad bcom nas dge ba gsum dang ldan par gyur cig

/sa ni dug gi pha yin te/ /sa ni dug gi ma yang yin/ /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis/ /dug gsum sa yi nang du song*/ /chu me rlung du 'don pa bsgyur ba'i tshig bzhi pa gsum brjod pa'i rjes su/ tshe las 'das pas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi 'byung ba bzhi la brten nas skyes pa'i rnam rtog rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad 'byung ba bzhi'i chos nyid kyi ngang du thim nas sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig / ces bya ba dang*/ bum pa'i chu gtor/ dril bu gsil zhing*/ gang la se sna rnam chags pa/ /rnam 'joms dri ma med mdzad cing*/ /thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams/ /thar pa'i lam du 'jug mdzad cing*/ /chos rnams thams cad ston pa de/ khyed la= ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten/ sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ / gang la bde ba mnga' mdzad des/ khyed la= skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yi/ / thugs kyis 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangs des/ khyed la= /gang zhig 'khor bar 'gro ba yi/ /sems can kun gyi rten gyur cig / gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des/ khyed la= /gang zhig chos kun mngon sum gyur/ /gtsang zhing bkru ba mi mnga' la/ /gsum gtsang gtsang mar mdzad pa des/ khyed la= dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pa/ /phun sum tshogs don gang 'byor zhing*/ /don grub tshogs kyang grub pa des/ khyed la=gang zhig skyes pas sa rnams ni/ /nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yos shing*/ /sems can thams cad rab dga' des/ khyed la= byang chub snying por gshegs pa na/ /sa dag rnam drug g.yos gyur zhing*/ /bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des/ khyed la= chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gsungs shing*/ /thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung des/ khyed la= yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed/ /thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing*/

/tshogs rnams dbang du mdzad pa des/ khyed la= sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad/ /brgya byin tshangs pa'i lha rnams dang*/ 'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni/ khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang*/ /lha rnams kun gyi bsam pa yis/ khyed kyi 'dod don gang yin pa/ /don de de ring 'grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog khyed cag lam 'gro bde legs shog /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing*/ khyed cag kun tu bde legs gyur/ khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /tshe las 'das pa che ge mos gtso byas pa'i skye rgu thams cad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las shin tu bkra shis shing rgyal bar gyur cig / ces brjod la/ de nas bu la sogs pa nye du yod na ming byang 'dzin du bcug cing*/ phyag byed du gzhug la/ gtso bo rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i don brtson pa/ /stobs chen 'jigs pa kun sel la/ /tshe 'das skyabs su mchi lags so/ /de yi thugs su chud pa'i chos/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel ba dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la yang*/ /de bzhin tshe 'das skyabs su mchi/ /tshe 'das 'jigs pa che mthong nas/ /kun tu bzang la tshe 'das 'bul//

'jam pa'i dbyangs la tshe 'das kyi/ /lus ni bdag gis dbul bar bgyi/ / thugs rje'i spyod pa ma 'khrul ba'i/ /spyan ras gzigs mgon de la yang*/ /nyam thag nga ros 'o dod 'bod/ /sdig ldan 'di la skyab tu gsol/ /'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po dang*/ /sa yi snying po dag dang ni/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid thams cad la/ /skyabs tshol snying nas 'o dod 'bod/ /gang zhig mthong na gshin rje yi/ /pho nya la sogs sdang ba rnams/ /skrag nas phyogs bcur 'byer byed pa/ / rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi/ /sngon chad khyod kyi bka' las 'das/ /da ni 'jigs pa che mthong nas/ khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyis/ /'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol/ /tshe las 'das pa che ge mo/ /zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung nas byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ brgyud ldan bla ma thugs rjes can/ /lha jo bo dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang*/ bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba thugs rje'i bdag po mi 'khrugs pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa/ byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'i sras brgyad dang bcas pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /sdig pa thams cad sbyang du gsol/ lam bstan du gsol/ myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes snying thag pa nas brjod cing*/ gsol ba 'debs par bsam mo/ /de nas gshin po la dbang mi bskur na 'og gi byang bu bsreg pa dang lam sbyang bstan sogs rdzogs par bya/ dbang bskur na skabs 'dir bya dgos pas/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas rjes zlos byed par bsam zhing*/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs nas dbang thams cad rdzogs par bskur ro/ /de ltar dbang bskur bas tshe 'das lha'i rang bzhin du gyur pa la mchod yon la sogs pa sngags tsam gyis mchod/ gzung 'dzin rdo rje brtan pa'i sa la sogs pa sho lo ka gcig gis bstod la/ lam sbyang bstan bya'o/

/yul kha cig na zas gtad dang*/ gos lham gtod pa sogs kyi lugs yod pa de ltar byed dgos byung na/ sngar ltar mchod bstaud byas pa'i rjes la/ 'dod yon sna tshogs pas tshe 'das lhar gyur pa mchod par bsam zhing*/ kha dog dbyibs legs sogs 'dod yon gyi tshigs bcad brjod do/ /nub tha ma la byang bu sreg par byed na/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsams la me sbar te/ stong nyid ye shes 'bar ba'i me/ /tshe 'das sgrib pa'i bud shing dang*/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus pa/ /ye shes snang bar 'bar gyur cig / ces dang*/ kāṃ ka ni brjod cing bsreg go /de nas lam sbyang bstan bya ste/ nub gong ma rnams la mchod pa'i rjes la/ nub tha ma la byang bu bsregs pa'i rjes la bya ste dril bu bsil/ me tog dor/ dkon mchog rin chen dpal zhing du/ /dkon mchog rin chen las byung ba'i/ /dkon mchog rin chen 'od zer gyis/ /rin chen 'phreng ba rnam dag pa/ /tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam/ /mthong ba'i lam dang sgom pa'i lam/ /byang chub bar chad med pa'i lam/ /bla na med pa'i khyad par lam/ /rnam par grol ba'i lam dag la/ / brten nas sdig pa kun sbyangs te/ /'phags pa'i lam der 'gro bar shog oṃ rat+ne rat+ne/ mahā rat+ne/ rat+na sam+bha we/ rat+na ki rat+ne/ rat+na mā la bi shud+dhe/ sho dha ya/ sarba pā paṃ nāṃ tra tha/ zhes dang rol mo bya/ pad+ma 'dam gyis ma gos ltar/ /srid gsum dri mas ma gos pa'i/ /srid pa'i pad+ma las byung ba'i/ /mngon par dga' bar skye bar shog / oṃ pad+me pad+me/ pad+ma saṃ bha we a bhi nan+da gats+tsha swāhā/ zhes brjod nas rol mo bya ste/ mngon par dga' bar skyes par bsam/ der skyes pa'i byang sems rnying pa rnams kyis phyis de la mchod par bsams la/ mchod cing rol mo bya'o/ / des kyang sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa 'khor dang bcas pa la mchod cing*/ rol mo bya'o/ / der skyes pa'i rgyu brtags pas rdo rje slob dpon gyi cho ga'i nus pa yin par shes te/

rdzu 'phrul gyis 'dir 'ongs nas/ bdag dang dkyil 'khor la mchod cing rol mo byas la/ e ma sangs rgyas e sangs rgyas/ /e ma sangs rgyas mdzad pa legs/ /gang phyir ngan song bdag cag sbyangs/ /byang chub spyod pa nyid la bzhag / ces ched du brjod par bsams la/ bdag gis kyang slar de la mchod pas mchod cing rol mo bya/ slar yang mngon par dga' bar song bar bsams la me tog dor/ de nas tshe 'das kyi don du smon lam rgyas par brjod cing*/ 'khor gsum mi dmigs pas rgyas btab ste/ gshin po rjes su bzung ba'i cho ga'o/ /drug pa rjes kyi cho ga ni/ gshin don yin na lam sbyang bstan tshar ba'i rjes dang*/ slob ma dbang bskur ba yin na/ dbang chog tshar ba'i rjes sam/ sgrub mchod rkyang pa yin na/ bdag 'jug tshar ba'i rjes la mchod pa rnams kha gsos/ bsangs sbyangs/ byin gyis rlabs nas mdun bskyed la phul bar bsam zhing*/ ngag tu/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba tā thā ga ta ak+ṣo bha sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hū ཾ / de bzhin du tshigs bcad 'og ma gnyis 'dra ba la/ chu skyes thang skyes yid las byung*/ /byang chub yan lag me tog 'di/ puṣ+pe/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar las byung*/ /a kar la sogs bdug spos 'di/ dhu pe/ rtsi mar 'bru mar mar me 'di/ /mi shes mun pa sel ba'i phyir/ ā lo ke /tsan+dan ga pur la sogs pa/ /lhan cig skyes sbyar dri mchog 'di/ gan+dhe/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya yis/ kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa'i/ /bla med bdud rtsi'i zhal zas 'di/ / 'bul gyi yang dag bzhes su gsol/ naiwid+ya= de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/
